The '''recon remote''' manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was a small and spherical [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by military and security personnel for reconnaissance and surveillance.<ref name="DC" />
